parameters.query: SELECT id, name, is_anonymized FROM public.customers WHERE phone = '{{$json.wa_id}}';
INSERT INTO public.customers (name, phone) VALUES ('{{$node["KE-AI-01-Message-Analysis"].json.name}}', '{{$node["KE-AI-01-Message-Analysis"].json.wa_id}}') RETURNING id;
SELECT id, mode, status FROM public.conversations WHERE customer_id = '{{$json.id}}' AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.messages (conversation_id, direction, content, whatsapp_message_id, status) VALUES ('{{$json.id}}', 'INBOUND', '{{$node["KE-AI-01-Message-Analysis"].json.content}}', '{{$node["KE-AI-01-Message-Analysis"].json.message_id}}', 'RECEIVED') ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id;

SELECT json_build_object('faqs', (SELECT json_agg(f) FROM (SELECT question, answer, keywords FROM public.faqs WHERE enabled = true) f), 'products', (SELECT json_agg(p) FROM (SELECT sku, name, category, description, specifications FROM public.products WHERE active = true) p), 'services', (SELECT json_agg(s) FROM (SELECT name, category, description, scope, sla FROM public.services WHERE active = true) s), 'prices', (SELECT json_agg(pr) FROM (SELECT price, currency, unit, pricing_type FROM public.prices WHERE active = true) pr), 'business_info', (SELECT json_agg(b) FROM (SELECT business_name, phone, address, business_hours, gstin FROM public.business_information WHERE active = true) b)) as knowledge_context;
